description: In the CN (SZ) warehouse, the picking list merges multiple lines of the same part into one line (combined qty); CN warehouse wants every order line listed separately, one line per part/order-line entry, so pickers can see each line's own qty
reproSteps: Open a picking order in the CN warehouse whose detail has the same part on multiple lines (e.g. different delivery lines/date codes); download/open the picking list → the part appears once with the total merged qty instead of one line per order line
remarks: CN (SZ) warehouse requirement — picking list must not merge parts into one line
